scale_pos_weight_policy: Number of negative training rows divided by positive training rows. Match the positive-to-negative emphasis ratio of balanced logistic loss; absolute loss scale and regularisation differ between algorithms.
selection_policy: One prespecified parameter configuration, fitted once per reviewed feature set. Validation selects boosting length through early stopping; it is development evidence, not an independent final evaluation.
input_policy: Same fitting rows and reviewed inputs as logistic references. No standardisation is applied to trees. Do not use target-day detection counts.
data_quality_policy: Retain original labels and every validation date, including the 22 December observation-quality concern.
final_test_policy: No final-test parsing, predictions, calibration or scores
